content.text:
I fixed the rounding bug in the VARCHAR → DECIMAL negative-exponent path. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested, and I didn't add a regression test.

**Cause:** `DecimalCastOperation::HandleExponent` in `src/include/duckdb/common/operator/decimal_cast_operators.hpp` divides the scaled value by 10 once per unit of the negative exponent. It stops as soon as the value reaches 0, and `round_up` keeps whatever the last digit it removed said. For `5.8207660913467407e-11` into `DECIMAL(18,4)`, the scaled value is 58207. After five divisions the last digit removed is the leading `5`, so it rounded up to 0.0001. That digit was actually many places below the last kept one, so the correct result is 0.

**Fix:** When the value reaches 0 before all the requested digits have been removed, `round_up` is now reset to `false`. A digit is only a rounding digit if it's the last one removed, which is the case when the loop runs its full length. Rounding for values like `5e-5` into `DECIMAL(18,4)` is unchanged.

I made the edit as a single-line insertion, so the file now has a few lines with LF endings among its CRLF ones. You may want to normalize them.
